It is commonly experienced by individuals exposed to environmental toxins, smokers, and those with chronic diseases such as diabetes or cardiovascular conditions. Scutellaria baicalensis, also known as Huang Qin, has been found to possess anti-oxidant properties that help combat oxidative stress by neutralizing harmful free radicals.
